profile.name: Karthick Raja G
profile.heroSummary: Built six projects independently this past year, spanning React and Node full-stack apps plus AWS and Docker systems designed to hold up under real users and real failures.
bio: I'm a DevOps and Full-Stack Developer pursuing B.Tech in Information Technology at Adhiparasakthi College of Engineering, Ranipet (2022-2026), with a CGPA of 7.8.
I split my time between writing application code and figuring out why something broke, with hands-on work across AWS, Docker, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and serverless systems.
I build full-stack systems with React and Node, automate infrastructure with Python, Bash, Terraform, boto3, and Fabric, and use AI-assisted tools to ship with more focus.

projects.title: Monitoring & Logging Stack - Prometheus, Grafana, Loki on AWS
projects.description: Set up a monitoring stack across four EC2 instances: Prometheus scrapes host metrics from a Python Flask app server, Promtail pushes app logs to Loki, and Grafana reads from both to build dashboards. Locked each tier down with Security Groups and admin or service-only access rules.

projects.title: VProfile - Dual CI/CD Pipeline
projects.description: Built Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines for the same application to compare the workflows side by side. Both pipelines run Maven build and test, SonarQube quality analysis, Trivy vulnerability scanning, Docker image builds, ECR publishing, and ECS deployment with secure secret retrieval.

projects.title: vprofile-project - AWS Microservices Deployment
projects.description: Set up a multi-tier architecture on AWS with EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer and Auto Scaling. Ran Tomcat, RabbitMQ, Memcache, and MySQL in separate Security Groups and pointed DNS through Route 53.

projects.title: Productivity Monitoring System
projects.description: Built a webcam-based system that tracks employee productivity in real time through face detection, emotion recognition, and behavior analytics, reaching around 95% accuracy. Dashboard updates stream live over WebSockets.

projects.title: OTT Video Streaming Platform
projects.description: Built an OTT platform on React.js, Node.js, Java, MySQL, and AWS S3 that scaled to 50,000+ monthly active users. Held 99.9% uptime and cut video load times by 30% by reworking the RESTful APIs and JWT auth flow.

projects.title: Learning Management System (LMS)
projects.description: Built a full-stack LMS covering course creation, enrollment, progress tracking, and an admin dashboard behind JWT authentication. Designed the RESTful APIs and MySQL schema from scratch.

projects.title: Serverless Web Application - Internshala
projects.description: Built a serverless app on AWS using S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, and Lambda with Python and Node.js, using DynamoDB for storage and secure CRUD operations through API Gateway.
